title: Eval questions
description: Test set for chat faithfulness, helpfulness, format, consistency. Expand to 50+ questions.

category.description: easy = metadata/first/last; tricky = ambiguous; adversarial = missing data; regression = bugs fixed

expected_intent.description: One of blog_summary, blog_lookup, seo_diagnosis, analytics_health, conversion_debug, how_to, admin, unknown

expected_mode.description: catalog_only = no retrieval; chunks = blog retrieval; analytics = GA4/GSC; combined

required_citations.description: Rule: e.g. 'Sources section when blog cited', 'Data window when analytics used'

must_not_hallucinate.description: e.g. ['no invented URLs', 'no numbers not in GA4/GSC']
